methodology.margin_model: expected margin = own season point differential/game - opponent's + home-field advantage
methodology.what_this_is_not: Retrospective, not predictive: ratings are full-season, so the model already knows how the season went. Games are treated as independent, ignoring injuries, weather and in-season improvement. It bounds the variance in a 17-game sample; it does not forecast.

close_games.note: A one-score game is decided by 8 points or fewer. Going well in these is weakly predictive year over year, which is why a strong one-score record is usually read as partly variance.

turnover_luck.note: Forcing a fumble is a skill; recovering one is close to a coin flip. This holds the recovery share at the league rate and leaves the forcing alone.
